method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited texts, seat-neutral core with one regulative rule and a seat layer for the senior, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE (no case needs a not-covered answer); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
